```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(tidygeocoder)
library(stringr)
library(leaflet)
library(scales)
library(htmltools)
```

```{r}
isaac=read_sav("spss/spss19/isaac1_6_7_core_ques_data.sav")|>
  janitor::clean_names()|>
  mutate(country_code=as.character(country),centre_code=as.character(centre), whezev=as.numeric(whezev),whez12=as.numeric(whez12),awake12=as.numeric(awake12),exwhez12=as.numeric(exwhez12))|>
  select(country_code,centre_code,whezev, whez12, awake12, exwhez12)

country=read_csv("spss/csv/isaac1_6_7_centre_info.csv")|>
  janitor::clean_names()|>
  mutate(country=as.character(country_name),centre=as.character(centre_name),country_code=as.character(country_code),centre_code=as.character(centre_code))|>
  select(country,country_code,centre,centre_code)|>
  mutate(
  centre= str_replace(
    centre,
    "\\s*\\d+\\s*[–-]\\s*\\d+\\s*$",
    ""
  ),
  centre = str_replace(
    centre,
    "\\s*\\(\\d+\\)\\s*$",
    ""
  ),
  centre = str_squish(centre),
  centre = iconv(centre, from = "", to = "UTF-8"),
  country= iconv(country, from = "", to = "UTF-8")
)|>
  mutate(country = if_else(
      country_code == 85,
      "Panama",
      country))
#remove some centre suffix like Sydney 6-7 or Madras (2) Madras (3) Madras (4) and let countrycode 85 be Panam


isaac|>
  distinct(country_code,centre_code)
country|>
  distinct(country_code,centre_code)
#make sure have some number of country and centre

isaac_country_centre=
  left_join(isaac,country,by=c("country_code","centre_code"))|>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(whezev, whez12, awake12, exwhez12),
      ~ na_if(as.numeric(.), 9)
    )
  )|>
  select(-country_code,-centre_code)|>
  group_by(country,centre)|>
  summarise(
    whezev_prev = sum(whezev == 1, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(!is.na(whezev)),
    whez12_prev = sum(whez12 == 1, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(!is.na(whez12)),
    awake12_prev = sum(awake12 > 2, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(!is.na(awake12)),
    exwhez12_prev = sum(exwhez12 == 1, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(!is.na(exwhez12)),
    n=n()
  )
 
isaac_country_centre
```

```{r}
fix_isaac_country_centre= 
  isaac_country_centre|>

fix_isaac_country_centre
```

```{r}
centres_geo=
  fix_isaac_country_centre|>
  tidygeocoder::geocode(
    city = centre,
    country = country,
    method = "osm",
    lat = lat,
    long = lon
  )
# find lat and lon which is helpful when create the map
centres_geo
```

```{r}
problem=
  centres_geo|>
  filter(is.na(lat) | is.na(lon))|>
  select(country,centre, lat,lon)
# find the country/ centre without lat and lon

problem
```

```{r}
centres_geo=
  centres_geo|>
  mutate(
    lat = case_when(
      country == "Hong Kong" & centre == "Hong Kong" ~ 22.3193,
      country == "Israel"    & centre == "Ramallah" ~ 31.9038,
      country == "Norway"    & centre %in% c("Nord–Trøndelag","Nord-Trøndelag") ~ 64.0139,
      country == "Panama"    & grepl("David", centre) ~ 8.4273,
      country == "Oman"      & centre %in% c("Al–Khod","Al-Khod") ~ 23.6139,
      TRUE ~ lat
    ),
    lon = case_when(
      country == "Hong Kong" & centre == "Hong Kong" ~ 114.1694,
      country == "Israel"    & centre == "Ramallah" ~ 35.2034,
      country == "Norway"    & centre %in% c("Nord–Trøndelag","Nord-Trøndelag") ~ 11.4954,
      country == "Panama"    & grepl("David", centre) ~ -82.4309,
      country == "Oman"      & centre %in% c("Al–Khod","Al-Khod") ~ 58.1644,
      TRUE ~ lon
    )
  )
# add the missing lat and lon by myself

centres_geo
```

```{r}

df= centres_geo |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    whezev_prev   = as.numeric(whezev_prev),
    whez12_prev   = as.numeric(whez12_prev),
    awake12_prev  = as.numeric(awake12_prev),
    exwhez12_prev = as.numeric(exwhez12_prev),
    n   = as.numeric(n),
    lat = as.numeric(lat),
    lon = as.numeric(lon)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(lon)) |>
  mutate(
    popup = sprintf(
      "<b>%s - %s</b><br/>
       Wheeze ever: %s<br/>
       Wheeze (12 mo): %s<br/>
       Night awakening: %s<br/>
       Exercise wheeze: %s<br/>
       n = %s",
      htmlEscape(country),
      htmlEscape(centre),
      percent(whezev_prev,   accuracy = 0.1),
      percent(whez12_prev,   accuracy = 0.1),
      percent(awake12_prev,  accuracy = 0.1),
      percent(exwhez12_prev, accuracy = 0.1),
      n
    )
  ) |>
  as.data.frame()  

pal= colorNumeric(
  palette = "viridis",
  domain  = df$whezev_prev,
  na.color = "#BEBEBE"
)

country_map= leaflet(data = df) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat,
    radius = ~pmax(3, sqrt(n) / 8),
    color  = ~pal(whezev_prev),
    stroke = TRUE, weight = 1, opacity = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.85,
    popup = ~popup   
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal, values = ~whezev_prev,
    title = "Wheeze ever prevalence",
    labFormat = labelFormat(transform = function(x) x * 100, suffix = "%", digits = 1)
  )

country_map
```
